1 شَخُتَ , (S, K,) aor.
شَخُتَ , inf. n. شُخُوتَةٌ, (K,) said of a man, (S,) [and app., in like manner, of anything,] He [or it] was, or became, thin, or slender, (S, L, K,) lean, and lank in the belly, not in consequence of emaciation. (L, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
